title: Mixing: Yes I’m Your Angel by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 1 October 1980.

This session saw work on the album revert back to the Hit Factory, after Lennon decided to move from the Record Plant at the end of the previous night’s session. From 10pm they worked on mixes of Ono’s song ‘Yes, I’m Your Angel’.

Page last updated: 18 May 2026
